## [A great company and fabulous selections](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/62e7e16c4c35e69ec5200579)
I have been in contact with LULU and GEORGIA ever since we were hit by a tornado Sept. 1st 2021. 

Their customer service has been terrific and have been working with me as the house is being built. 

Can't wait till my items arrive.
